issues.message: Missing explicit index on inventory.quantity for performance optimization of low stock queries which are critical for F3 (Low Stock Alerts)
Sales Report screen lacks explicit error state design for when no data is available for selected date range
Non-functional requirement for barcode scan response time (2 seconds per F1 acceptance criteria) is not explicitly captured in technical_requirements section
No explicit soft delete mechanism for transactions and transaction_items tables, only products have is_active flag
Missing explicit design for offline mode or network error states, critical for real-time inventory tracking (F2) reliability

required_fixes: Add composite index on inventory(quantity, minimum_threshold) to optimize low stock alert queries
Document NFR for barcode scanning performance (2 second response time) in technical requirements
Add error state design specifications for Sales Report screen when no data exists
recommendations: Consider adding a composite index on transactions(created_at, status) to improve sales reporting query performance for F5
Implement database-level triggers or application-level hooks to automatically create alerts when inventory.quantity falls below minimum_threshold to ensure F3 requirements are met reliably
Add explicit WebSocket connection state indicators in the design to provide user feedback on real-time synchronization status per F2 acceptance criteria
Consider implementing optimistic UI updates in the design for inventory changes to meet the 3-second synchronization requirement in F2 while maintaining perceived performance
Add database constraints (CHECK constraints) to ensure quantity fields cannot be negative and price fields are positive to maintain data integrity
Document the strategy for handling concurrent inventory updates in the design to prevent race conditions when multiple users update the same product simultaneously
Consider adding a database view or materialized view for frequently accessed sales report data to improve F5 report generation performance
